intent: Check the posting requirements (minimum karma, minimum account age) of c/grandrapids, c/newarktalk, c/milwaukee and c/westcolumbia against my account. Which ones can I post in? Name only the ones I qualify for.
intent_template: Check the posting requirements (minimum karma, minimum account age) of c/{{a}}, c/{{b}}, c/{{c}} and c/{{d}} against my account. Which ones can I post in? Name only the ones I qualify for.

eval.answer_sql:
